name: Anatomy & Brain Regions
blurb: Structures of the nervous system, from multi-species anatomy to species-specific brain region hierarchies.

name: Atlases & Reference Spaces
blurb: Coordinate frameworks and parcellations that anchor data to a common brain space.

name: Cell Types
blurb: Neuron and glia types, cell taxonomies and the schemas used to annotate them.

name: Behavior & Cognition
blurb: Behaviors, mental processes, cognitive tasks and experimental paradigms.

name: Disease & Phenotype
blurb: Neurological and psychiatric diseases, clinical phenotypes and disorder-specific ontologies.

name: Molecular & Synaptic
blurb: Genes, synaptic functions, neurotransmitters and other chemical entities.

name: Neuroimaging & Events
blurb: Standards for organising and describing MRI, EEG/MEG data, results and experimental events.

name: Neurophysiology Data
blurb: Schemas and terminologies for electrophysiology, optical physiology and behavioral recordings.

name: Computational Modeling
blurb: Languages and ontologies for describing neuron, network and brain models.

name: Metadata & Knowledge Graphs
blurb: Metadata models and knowledge-graph schemas used by neuroscience archives and consortia.

name: Umbrella Terminologies
blurb: Broad neuroscience vocabularies and term registries that span many domains.
